ndex+1).padStart(2,'0')} / ${FLOW.length}`;$('#promptTitle').textContent=st.title;$('#promptText').textContent=st.instruction;hotspotLabel.textContent=st.label;promptCard.classList.add('show');reminder.classList.remove('show');promptTimer=setTimeout(()=>{promptCard.classList.remove('show');reminder.innerHTML=`화면을 드래그해 둘러보고 <b>${st.label}</b>의 노란 외곽선을 클릭하세요.`;reminder.classList.add('show');},2600);guideTimer=setTimeout(()=>guideToTarget(),8000);updateProgress();}
function updateProgress(){$('#progressBar').style.width=(Math.min(stepIndex,FLOW.length)/FLOW.length*100)+'%';}
function showFeedback(st){clearTimeout(feedbackTimer);promptCard.classList.remove('show');reminder.classList.remove('show');$('#feedbackTitle').textContent='확인했습니다';$('#feedbackText').textContent=st.feedback;feedbackCard.classList.add('show');feedbackTimer=setTimeout(()=>feedbackCard.classList.remove('show'),1450);}
async function advance(){if(stepIndex>=FLOW.length)return;clearTimeout(guideTimer);const st=currentStep();showFeedback(st);hotspot.classList.remove('visible');await new Promise(r=>setTimeout(r,1500));stepIndex++;updateProgress();if(stepIndex>=FLOW.length){$('#progressBar').style.width='100%';$('#completeCard').classList.add('show');return;}const next=currentStep();if(next.scene!==currentSceneId){await enterScene(next.scene);}showPrompt();}
hotspot.addEventListener('click',e=>{e.preventDefault();e.stopPropagation();advance();});
function updateHotspot(){if(!started||stepIndex>=FLOW.length||currentStep().scene!==currentSceneId){hotspot.classList.remove('visible');return;}const t=stTarget();const cp=Math.cos(pitch),sp=Math.sin(pitch),cy=Math.cos(yaw),sy=Math.sin(yaw);const forward=[sy*cp,sp,cy*cp],right=[cy,0,-sy],up=[-sy*sp,cp,-cy*sp];const cpt=Math.cos(t.pitch),dir=[Math.sin(t.yaw)*cpt,Math.sin(t.pitch),Math.cos(t.yaw)*cpt];const lx=dir[0]*right[0]+dir[1]*right[1]+dir[2]*right[2];const ly=dir[0]*up[0]+dir[1]*up[1]+dir[2]*up[2];const lz=dir[0]*forward[0]+dir[1]*forward[1]+dir[2]*forward[2
